name: Athenas Traditional White Pita Bread Pockets
whyItWorks: Traditional Middle Eastern flatbread baked at high heat from unbleached enriched flour. The puff forms a gentle pocket with under 1g fiber and zero seeds or whole grains.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm in a toaster or microwave for 15 seconds. Stuff with shredded chicken breast and cucumber slices.
